shortDescription: SSB Constable to Sub Inspector (Non-GD)-2025 PET/PST e-Admit Card has been released. PET/PST commenced from 08 August 2026.
content:
Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB) has released the e-Admit Card for Constable to Sub Inspector (Non-GD)-2025 PET and PST.

The official SSB recruitment portal shows the e-Admit Card notice dated 07 August 2026 and the commencement notice for PET/PST dated 29 July 2026. The official admit-card page lists the physical stage from 08 August 2026, with the listed schedule extending up to 13 October 2026 for the relevant posts.

Candidates should download the e-Admit Card from the official SSB recruitment portal and follow the date, venue and reporting instructions mentioned on their individual call letter.
